verdict.rationale: LegalOS has dedicated startup and enterprise persona pages. The enterprise page targets People, Operations and hiring teams, moves plural cases toward filing readiness, and keeps case visibility within one immigration team, so employer-side, multi-hire use is a stated offering. However, the evidence is marketing-level. Nothing documents an actual multi-case dashboard, team-wide tracking, or volume and scale-up program terms. missing for 10: documented multi-case or portfolio management tooling, explicit scale-up program terms such as volume pricing or dedicated account handling, independent or hands-on corroboration of team-level case handling.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, I can run visas for a growing team through one provider — multi-case management or a stated startup/scale-up program beyond single founder cases

citations.quote: LegalOS helps startups identify the right visa or green card path, collect the evidence, and prepare attorney-reviewed filings in as little as 48 hours.
Give People, Operations, Finance, and hiring teams direct attorney guidance before the hire, then move cases toward filing readiness in 48–72 hours
LegalOS keeps preparation, attorney review, filing, and case visibility within one accountable immigration team.
LegalOS helps organize employer and candidate materials in one structured workflow.
